doc: Milestone M3's extension of the ledger (holon.records.milestone_extensions, milestone_entries; I68, rule S8 of tests_m3/test_structural_keys.py). The M3 model of I20's extracted rollup document (holon.sorts.model3: the typed model, its untyped twin and the UNDO, FACT and DISCH sections built on them) stores by structural keys (holon.sorts.prelude3.PRELUDE_SK, holon-model-m3/0.3) where the M2 model stores by real slots: the entry below is the assumption that this adds, read by holon.records for records of milestone M3 (the typed runners pass their milestone) and met only by a cone that holds the structural store's key type SK, so no record over I28's raw versioned machine, no PAR record and no M0-M2 record lists it. spec/M2/ledger.json and the base ledger do not change.

entries.text: A storage location is a structural key SK{b, o, p}: the family's base slot b, the offset o inside the top-level variable and the hashed steps p, each a mapping key k with the offset inside its value. Its real slot is b + o, then keccak256(pad32(k) ++ pad32(slot)) + offset for each step, all mod 2**256. The store compares keys by sk_eq, by structure: two different keys are two different slots, which holds when keccak256 has no collision on the real slots the contract reaches and no structural key's real slot is a raw or literal slot (CF(keccak256, the reached images)). R5's storage comparisons on the frozen I20 corpus and holon keys (gen/M3/sorts/keys.json: the keys of the deployment, the corpus and every committed witness and inhabitant, with each collision listed as a finding) check it on what holon runs.
